input.description: A 3-D `Tensor` of the format specified by `data_format`.

ksize.description: An int or list of `ints` that has length `1` or `3`. The size of the window for each dimension of the input tensor.

strides.description: An int or list of `ints` that has length `1` or `3`. The stride of the sliding window for each dimension of the input tensor.

padding.description: A string, either `'VALID'` or `'SAME'`. The padding algorithm. See [here](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/nn#notes_on_padding_2) for more information.
constraints: padding must be one of VALID, SAME

data_format.description: An optional string from: "NWC", "NCW". Defaults to "NWC".

output.description: A `Tensor` of format specified by `data_format`. The max pooled output tensor.
